# PPOI proof fixtures

`ppoi_3x3.json`, `ppoi_3x3_two_outputs.json`, and `ppoi_13x13_unshield.json`
contain public synthetic Groth16
proofs generated by `railgun-wallet/tests/ppoi_artifacts.rs`. The public seed,
note randomness, zero-sibling membership paths, and amounts are defined there.
No production wallet data or large proving binaries belong in these fixtures.

The bundle is `QmZ2MyM6TKxffkv6stuo2hFwmUfs3q4xgMYN164Sje8new`, selected by
`@railgun-community/wallet` 11.2.0. Decompressed zkey and WASM hashes come from
`railgun-wallet/resources/metadata/artifact-v2-hashes.json`. The integration
check compares every provisioned file with that manifest before proving.

Provision these decompressed files under an explicit cache directory:

```text
artifacts-v2.1/QmZ2MyM6TKxffkv6stuo2hFwmUfs3q4xgMYN164Sje8new/POI_3x3/zkey
artifacts-v2.1/QmZ2MyM6TKxffkv6stuo2hFwmUfs3q4xgMYN164Sje8new/POI_3x3/wasm
artifacts-v2.1/QmZ2MyM6TKxffkv6stuo2hFwmUfs3q4xgMYN164Sje8new/POI_13x13/zkey
artifacts-v2.1/QmZ2MyM6TKxffkv6stuo2hFwmUfs3q4xgMYN164Sje8new/POI_13x13/wasm
```

Run from the railgun-rust workspace with both directories outside the repo:

```sh
PPOI_ARTIFACT_CACHE=/absolute/provisioned/cache PPOI_FIXTURE_OUTPUT=/absolute/generated/proofs \
  cargo test --locked -p railgun-wallet --test ppoi_artifacts prove_current_ppoi_shapes -- --ignored --exact --nocapture
```

Missing files, incorrect hashes, failed witnesses, or failed verification fail
the test. It has no download gateways and no network fallback. It proves one
input to one private output with the 3x3 circuit, one input to two private
outputs for recovery-group tests, then one input to three private outputs
plus an unshield with the 13x13 circuit. The latter protects
the circuit-selection boundary where the unshield counts as a fourth output.
Each proof passes zkey verification and the independently embedded core key;
a changed transaction root fails verification.

Each generated JSON contains the persisted `PreTxPoi`, actual transaction
counts, circuit public signals, public transaction identifiers and output
commitments/npks, and conventional snarkjs proof and decimal public-signal
exports. Independently verify the `snarkjs_proof` and
`snarkjs_public_signals` fields with `snarkjs.groth16.verify` against the
authenticated corresponding `vkey.json`. Also require rejection after changing
one public signal. Record the verifier version, artifact hashes, effective
commands, and results in the controlling change's `verification.md`.

`verify-ppoi.cjs` performs this check using a checksum-pinned snarkjs 0.7.6
browser bundle without installing npm dependencies. Its header specifies the
download and extraction instructions. Run:

```sh
node crates/core/tests/fixtures/verify-ppoi.cjs /absolute/snarkjs.js /absolute/generated/proofs
```

Copy the three generated JSON files here only after those independent checks
pass. Groth16 proof randomness changes their bytes on regeneration. Normal
core tests read the retained files offline, reconstruct the persisted signal
order, verify all proofs, and reject mutations and the wrong boundary shape.

`ppoi_3x3_previous.json` and `ppoi_3x3_two_outputs_previous.json` are valid
proofs for the previous `poi-nov-2-23` bundle using the same synthetic witnesses
with one input and one or two private outputs. They were generated
in an isolated checkout of `b770ba7c05a5d33d904f518fd29dd05badd36008` with
the integration harness above restricted to its 3x3 cases. The old zkey and
WASM were checked against that checkout's embedded hashes:

| Artifact | Decompressed SHA-256 |
| --- | --- |
| 3x3 zkey | `667984c51df2122956107c11c3c606e4e4688f70fb25515b9388cbd5140e48b3` |
| 3x3 WASM | `831aad53c05d19f9854ed27429610da724fbdf9e1e7023aa7a90666f50b0da78` |
| 3x3 vkey | `92120a7dfda25cc56c79ce7047f2ff8596f4d96e95dcdc2ff4d599a5cdcf5c56` |

The old proofs passed both the old embedded Rust verifier and the same pinned
snarkjs verifier against the old vkey; changing a public signal failed both.
To repeat the reference check, restrict `verify-ppoi.cjs` to its 3x3 cases
and use the old checkout's vkey and the vkey checksum above. Current-key tests
must reject these fixtures. They protect the persisted-proof migration from
accepting cryptographically valid proofs produced before the bundle change.

`ppoi_3x3_external_previous.json` uses the same old artifacts and one-input,
one-output witness, with the output's master public key derived from the public
synthetic seed `[43; 64]` instead of the sender's `[42; 64]`. The input value is
100, input randomness `[1; 16]`, output value 100, output randomness `[2; 16]`,
token address `[0x11; 20]`, input tree/position 0/0 and bound-params hash 7.
It was generated and independently verified with the same commands and pinned
old key. It supports exact-spend external-output recovery through real proving.

The provisioned sync-service check exercises source-block reconstruction,
current proof generation, durable replacement and submission to a verifying
local mock. It uses the external old-proof fixture, local public-data fixtures
and the same cache directory above:

```sh
PPOI_ARTIFACT_CACHE=/absolute/provisioned/cache \
  cargo test --locked -p sync-service --lib wallet::tests::saved_poi_migration_tests::exact_spend_recovery_regenerates_previous_external_proof_and_submits_current_proof -- --ignored --exact
```

This check submits no proofs to a real POI node and uses no funded wallets.
